methodology.split: stratified large-scale 100k+ corpus split (86,998 train / 1,500 val / 2,500 held-out test); preprocessing fitted on training data only
methodology.macro_f1: unweighted mean of per-class F1; gives each sentiment class equal importance
methodology.weighted_f1: mean of per-class F1 weighted by class support
methodology.caution: Test-set results estimate performance for this split and score-derived labels; they are not human-annotated validation.
